WITH state_totals AS (
  SELECT
    c.State,
    SUM(i.Total) AS total_invoice_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS invoice_count
  FROM Invoice AS i
  JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
  WHERE CAST(i.InvoiceDate AS TEXT) BETWEEN '2010-06-22 00:00:00' AND '2012-06-26 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY c.State
)
SELECT
  SUM(total_invoice_amount) AS sum_of_state_totals,
  AVG(invoice_count) AS average_invoices_per_state
FROM state_totals;

assumptions.assumption: The date bounds are inclusive, as implied by “between,” and InvoiceDate is cast to text for comparison.
